title: MedBench: A Comprehensive, Standardized, and Reliable Benchmarking System for Evaluating Chinese Medical Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Applying circular shuffling to choices in multiple-choice questions to detect if models tend to choose answers in a preferred positional order regardless of the actual context.
Using random prompt matching with multiple different prompts for the same question to assess if the model's performance is biased by or dependent on specific input and output patterns.
